[[Galigord's Stone Staff]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[staff]] dropped by [[Galigord Stonestrike]], a [[boss]] in [[Sorrow's Furnace]].

== Stats ==
:[[Energy]] +15
:[[Earth damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Earth Magic]]) 
:Halves skill recharge of [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%) 
:Halves casting time of [[Earth Magic]] [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%) 
:[[Enchantments]] last 20% longer
:Two-handed

== Skin ==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Earth Staff (crystallized)]].
